text:
Amelia: Heads up — enterprise onboarding asked for role templates that can attach per-route quotas and routing tiers. current role modal has no place to express route-level quota/policy.
Devin: We should allow binding roles to routes with an optional quota override. UX could be a multi-select route picker + quota field.
Sanjay: API concern: stuffing routeBindings into Roles breaks our existing Roles API v1 contract. I think a separate RoleBinding resource is cleaner: { role_id, route_id, quotas... }.
Leah: :thinking_face: product tradeoff — single object simplifies console flows (fewer calls) but adds coupling. Are there security implications if role and binding lifecycle differ?
Mike: From infra side we also need telemetry. If we introduce bindings, emit events: rbac.binding.create, rbac.binding.fail, rbac.binding.apply_mismatch. We should track overassigns per-org.
Amelia: Rollout idea: UI behind ff, backend accepts payload but ignores it by default unless org opt-in. Canary by org level, gradual migration.
Devin: Proposed role payload (draft):
```json
{
  "id": "role.example/admin",
  "name": "Admin (with route bindings)",
  "permissions": ["routes:invoke","routes:configure"],
  "routeBindings": [
    { "route": "model-prod/gpt-large", "quota": { "tokens_per_minute": 10000 }, "routingTier": "dedicated" }
  ]
}
```
Sanjay: If we go this route we need migration + fallback: API should reject unknown route ids and surface partial failures. That impacts UX: the modal should show per-binding validation inline.
Leah: UX ask: show effective quota preview for the org (sum of bindings, reserved capacity) before commit. Also an escape hatch to revert bindings in 1 click.
Mike: I'll add dashboard cards: "RBAC binding success rate" and "Effective per-route quota by org" + alert when binding causes quota > reserved capacity. We'll need sample queries for traces.
ops-bot: deploybot: roles-service v2 with binding-schema deployed to staging at sha: ab12cd3 — watch staging logs.
Amelia: Cool. Action items: @Devin prepare API sketch + validation behavior, @Sanjay estimate infra/migration cost, @Leah mock preview UI, @Mike add telemetry metrics + dashboard prototypes. Sync tomorrow 11:00am PST.
Devin: noted. I'll post API sketch in #eng-platform tomorrow morning.
Leah: I'll bring a quick mock (Figma link) to the sync. :thumbsup:
Mike: Adding initial PromQL and alert thresholds this afternoon.
Amelia: Thanks team :rocket:
